Land Price

Many of you have heard the rumors over the past six months of how our land pricing would be structured. While the rumor of $100-$5000 usd has been a fun range to chat about, the numbers below reflect our actual land prices.. So… congrats! There are no land plots anywhere close to $5000 usd!

IMPORTANT: We will be snapshotting the price of ADA, which is the currency you will actually use to purchase land, on Jun 2, 2022 at 18:00 UTC. We will then convert the land prices from USD over to ADA based on the price at the time of the snapshot. 

Small: $102usd / worth of ADA
Medium: $240usd / worth of ADA
Large: $375usd / worth of ADA
Epic: $755usd / worth of ADA
Copias: $1500usd / worth of ADA

Utility and Rarity of Land Plots

Our land plots are broken down by size and rarity. Our land sizes are as follows: Small, Medium, Large, Epic, and Copias. Each size is further broken down into these rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary, and Mythic. So, what does this mean? 

The size should speak for itself in terms of classification. What does rarity mean in regards to land? Our land rarities will determine your place in line when we have our official Cornucopias “Land Rush.” We will also offer land staking and/or airdrops in the future. We do not have details on these reward programs yet, but rarity will come into play with each.

What is the Cornucopias Land Rush? 

As Cornucopias production progresses, we will be releasing maps that represent each Zone, Sector and District. Land owners will have access to these maps in advance and will be able to study features like water, proximity to mines, locations with beautiful views, etc. This will allow owners to strategically plan out where they would like to stake a claim for each land NFT. The order in which land can be claimed is indicated by rarity. In other words, the rarer your land deed, the better chance you have of staking claim to a plot in a more desirable location (close to water, mining, etc).

How Tiers Work

Our minting system is designed for us to exercise very fine control of how we mint our NFTs. This is one of the incredible features that sets our marketplace apart from others. As most of you know, we have a tier system (based on Discord roles) for the minting process. Your tier determines the order you will have access to the mint. A higher tier means you will have earlier access to the mint.

For each sale, we have allocated a percentage of supply to each tier. How do we execute this during a sale? Our system allows us to release NFTs in batches. Each batch released has the exact same ratio of rarities to ensure that it is a fair process. 

For example, if we have 500 NFTs allocated to the OG tier, and our batch size is 50, we would release 10 batches of NFTs to equal a total of 500 for that tier. Each batch would contain the exact same rarity percentages so that no matter what, every tier allocation has an equal opportunity to mint a mythic, legendary, etc.

Next we will cover BEST PRACTICES... 

I realize there are other mints happening over the next few days, some of which are big. We strongly advise to reserve a separate wallet for Cornucopias mints. IN OTHER WORDS... Do not show up to our mint having minted another NFT or executing any other transaction moments before. And do not use your wallet until you have received your NFT (if you happen to be successful). 

- A NEW Wallet is less problematic

- Turn off all security plugins in your browser (shield, bitdefender, malwarebytes)

- AVOID making any other transactions a few hours before the mint, and until your NFT is safely in your Wallet.

- Wallets with many NFTs in them are problematic, because ADA is locked up in the UTXOs of those NFT assets. You may not have as much spendable ADA as you think. 

- Having plenty of ADA in the wallet is important, as it lessens the chance that you will have a failed transaction.

- DO NOT retry transactions until the Team has specifically told YOU to do this.

- DO NOT SEND ADA TO OUR PAYMENT ADDRESS We will not be able to refund your ADA for at least 5 days... and you just won't get an NFT by doing this.

@everyone 

Congratulations to everyone who participated in the historical Cornucopias mint over the past 2 days. Each day has been a huge success with multiple tiers selling out in less than 20 seconds!!!

All records are being re-written thanks to your amazing support and belief in our project.

We have loved seeing all your images within our Discord and publicly on Twitter, please keep this up - you are bringing huge awareness to our project and technology.

Yesterday we suspected the early 3-tiers were selling their NFTs below the mint price and spoiling it for later tiers. This also had an effect on the public tier who were confused at some secondary prices being lower than mint prices. Today the backend data confirmed this theory. 

In response to this, to make the mint fair to all, for the remaining 3 Land Plot sales, we will start the distribution of the NFTs after 10pm UTC, or earlier if the NFTs sell out during Tier 4.

This first NFT land sale is for 3 themed zone land plots. The remaining 9 themed zone land plots will be sold over the next couple of years as the artwork, maps, and accompanying NFTs are created. 

The next themed zone land plot sales will not be until Q3 2023 at the earliest. These early  limited land plots will give access to beta testing and the initial game release this year.

The next NFT sale will be for the Custom Domes (see https://copiwiki.cornucopias.io/gameplay/gameplay-pc/custom-domes/custom-dome-standard-templates). 90% of the 5,000 Custom Dome NFTs on offer will be restricted to OG, land NFT Holders and flying vehicle NFT holders.

It is also worth noting that the technology we are bringing to Cardano is second to none. We have invested heavily in building our NFT minting technology which is extremely eco-friendly to the congested ecosystem we all love.

Early adopters on Cardano and Cornucopias stand at the forefront of the next generation of blockchain and gaming technology. It is an absolute honor to be developing on this global stage.

Next week at the Cardano meet-up and Consensus we will be demonstrating in Person the first Unreal Engine 5 game to be built on the Cardano Blockchain. We have a full schedule of meetings arranged with Influencers, Institutions and even IOHK themselves.

Tomorrow @ 1PM UTC the two CEOs Josh and Rob will be hosting a 30 minute AMA session on Discord to answer any questions you may have and to share in the success of our community-based project.

We are all part of a historical movement and we have come a long way in the last 12 months from a self-funded 4 man team, to the 40+ incredibly talented experienced team you see today - all with the same vision to build a world class Web3 Metaverse that will cross over into mainstream gaming and bring floods of people and awareness to Play-to-Earn, Build-to-Earn, Learn-to-Earn and Host-To-Earn gaming. It will also show that Cardano is “The Number 1” Blockchain for nextgen gaming, defi and community-driven projects.

And finally, most importantly — you, our community.  We have so much fun building with you and watching what you create.  Let’s keep this going— we can’t wait to empower you with our building tools and early testing releases.

You just witness someone using a bot. The funny thing is that they triggered it before the sale started so their entries were rejected by our system. How embarassing for them

@everyone 

As you all know, on the first few sales, we only showed the number of items still available on the sale tier. 

Since there is a delay on processing queue entries, some people did not understand why they did not get a reservation after they entered the que successfully while there were still available items shown. 

As such, we added the new UI element to show the number of Unprocessed Queue Items under the available items. This was to give the community transparency, to show that the available items only decrements when a queue entry is processed successfully. 
 
However, any entries that were submitted before the open time were unsuccessful. That is why the number of Unprocessed Entries went back down to 0 while the Available items remained at 80.

The reality of our situation is that we have thousands of people competing for 80 nfts. The demand is monumental. As we have said before, this is our first mint with this much demand and hype, and everything that we learn from this mint will be improved for the next. 

We will continue with our scheduled mint for Tier 3 at 17:00 UTC (In 1hr)
